title: Flowserve Announces the Appointment of Alice DeBiasio as President of Flow Control Division
summary: Flowserve Corporation (NYSE: FLS) (“Flowserve”), a leading provider of flow control products and services for the global infrastructure markets, has announced that Alice DeBiasio will join the company as President of the Flow Control Division, beginning Monday, Oct. 13, 2025. Alice DeBiasio is an accomplished leader with extensive experience leading global industrial organizations and driving consistent profitable growth, innovation and customer loyalty. Most recently, DeBiasio served as Vice President, General Manager at Carrier Corporation, where she led multiple business segments, including Truck Trailer Americas, Sensitech and Digital Solutions for the entire Climate Solutions Transportation divisions.
